notes.title: Chicken Life on Family Land – Let’s Talk Feathers and Eggs! 🐔 🥚
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/9904c5b7a6353d6ef5a05410a27fc738e6fa3a6a.png

Hey, farmers!

Every animal on Family Land has its own cozy home—whether it’s Uncle, happily chilling in his treehouse 🌳, the cows grazing in their shed 🐄, or the chickens ruling their coop 🐔. As your farm grows, you’ll be able to upgrade these buildings, making them bigger and better. More room means more animals, and trust us, your animals will thank you for the improved digs (well, maybe not in words, but definitely in eggs and milk!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/b1fea30a7e1018274f97bc1e4c5f07ede5677d7e.gif

Speaking of chickens, let’s dive into our favorite feathery friends. Chickens aren’t just for looks; they need food and water to be at their best. 🐓 Keep them happy, and they’ll climb up the ranks in our star system—the more stars, the more eggs you’ll be rolling in! 💫🥚 Plus, watching them strut around in their upgraded coop? Pure satisfaction.

Now, before we sign off, we want to give you a behind-the-scenes peek at what our chickens look like before they even make it to the farm! Here’s a screenshot of the chicken model straight from the engine—check out those feathers! 😄

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/efae8661a9a8b3b74aa62f97a2a881d4799862e0.gif

Thanks for being with us on this wild farming ride! Keep following for more updates—we’ve got a lot more in store for you. 🚜🐥

We also have some exciting news! The Family Land - Farmer Simulator Prologue page is now live on Steam – soon, you’ll get a chance to try out the first free sample of our game!

The Family Land Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3185480/Family_Land__Farmer_Simulator_Prologue/

notes.title: Devlog #24: Vehicle Refueling Mechanics
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/0437d8210ad83890cc7933520b376fa6014ab793.png

Welcome back, farmers! 

In today's devlog, we’re diving into one of the essential aspects of running a successful farm: keeping your vehicles fueled and ready to go. Every vehicle in Family Land - Farmer Simulator depends on fuel, whether it’s the trusty pickup you use for quick trips around the farm or the hardworking tractor that handles your daily chores.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/a739e4b836a71c3de95e5dbe256d2df8b088d15c.gif

Fueling Up Your Pickup and Tractor

As you drive around in your pickup, making those essential deliveries and exploring the countryside, you'll eventually find yourself at the farm’s gas station. Equipped with two large fuel tanks, this station will keep your pickup running smoothly. But don’t forget about the tractor! It's your right hand in the fields, helping you plow, sow, and harvest crops. To keep it going, you’ll need to refuel regularly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/0f9f0baae8ea056b90db14152875ffe58b16ce76.gif

Running on Empty? Here’s What to Do

If you find yourself in a situation where the fuel gauge hits zero, don’t worry – we’ve got you covered. Simply head over to your home office and dial 801-802-803. This handy number connects you to a fuel delivery service, allowing you to refill your tanks without leaving the farm. But remember, refueling isn’t free! Make sure you’ve got enough money in the bank because, as with any farm, running out of funds can slow you down.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/c911ebf051879e36d711ca77e6082fe77746f49a.gif

Thank You for Your Support!

We truly appreciate your continued support and enthusiasm for Family Land - Farmer Simulator! Be sure to check out Universum Gas Station, where you'll likely find some fantastic game deals and other exciting offers. Stay tuned for more updates as we work hard to bring you the best farming experience possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/22826d44cebe88af13ea1979f3e2338294588e40.jpg

Happy farming, and see you next time!

notes.title: Devlog #23: The Magic of Day and Night in Family Land ☀️🌙
notes.content:
Hello Farmers!

Welcome to Devlog #23 for Family Land! Today, we’re excited to take you through the enchanting cycle of day and night on your farm. Each time of day brings its own unique atmosphere and beauty, enhancing your farming experience like never before. Let’s dive in and explore the different times of the day from various perspectives!

Morning: A New Beginning

As the first rays of the sun peek over the horizon, our farm awakens with a serene glow. The morning light bathes the fields in a soft, golden hue, making everything look fresh and vibrant. Birds start chirping, and you can feel the crisp morning air as you step outside to begin your day. It's a perfect time to start tending to your crops and feeding the animals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/d968904184f877c9722de44c412f24861cabb9df.gif

Afternoon: The Sun at Its Peak

By the time afternoon rolls around, the sun is high in the sky, casting a bright and intense light over the farm. The warmth of the day is perfect for working in the fields, though be sure to stay hydrated! Shadows are short, and the landscape is bathed in vivid colors, showcasing the beauty of your well-maintained farm. It’s the busiest time of the day, with lots of activities happening simultaneously.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/e4f93bac20461555fcc8c0c5a1ae874a0bd3b7d9.gif

Evening: The Golden Hour

As the sun begins its descent behind the hills, the farm is graced with the stunning colors of dusk. The sky transforms into a canvas of oranges, pinks, and purples, creating a picturesque scene that is truly breathtaking. This is the time when the farm starts to wind down, and you can enjoy the tranquility of the evening. It’s a perfect moment to relax and reflect on the day's work while watching the sun set.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/d132ccdf9502c43caa81c31f29405580c4f590f5.gif

Night: A Sky Full of Stars

When night falls, the farm is enveloped in a peaceful darkness. The sky is adorned with countless stars, and if you’re lucky, you might even catch a glimpse of the northern lights painting the sky with their magical glow. The quiet of the night is occasionally interrupted by the sounds of nocturnal wildlife. It's the ideal time to rest and recharge for the next day, with the gentle lullaby of nature in the background.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/b0ad5e35b9635c87485d4e27d654136337ff285a.gif

And That's Not All!

While we're thrilled to share the beauty of the day and night cycle in Family Land, we also have some exciting news from our friends working on a new project. They've just released a teaser for Car Dealer Simulator, and it's looking fantastic! Be sure to check it out on the Steam page for more details.
Thank you for reading, and we can't wait to share more updates with you soon. Happy farming!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

Stay tuned for more!
The Family Land Team

notes.title: Devlog #21 - Summer in full swing in Family Land - Farmer Simulator! 🌞🚜
notes.content:
Hello, Farmers!

We hope you're enjoying the summer as much as we are! With the Steam Summer Sale now in full swing, we have some exciting updates and news to share about our ongoing work on Family Land - Farmer Simulator. Get ready to learn about the latest additions to our game and take advantage of some fantastic discounts!

Summer Sale and In-Game Shopping Mechanics

Just like the Steam Summer Sale helps you stock up on great games at unbeatable prices, our latest update focuses on enhancing the shopping mechanics in Family Land to keep your farm running smoothly. To ensure your farm operates at its best, every farmer needs to manage supplies efficiently. Here's what you need to know:


 Animal Feed: Your animals need to eat to stay healthy and productive. Make sure to stock up on feed for your chickens and cows.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/a728811150663ac2266fec6c303ad545e8c42c62.gif

 Seeds: To keep your fields lush and green, you'll need a variety of seeds for planting. Keep your crops rotating and your silos full!
 Fuel: Your trusty tractor and other machinery need fuel to keep running. Unlike other resources, fuel must be purchased rather than gathered.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/dad1fd7a02e8631ebfe9a9362766787f0b36f4c5.gif

In Family Land, you will handle all these transactions right from the comfort of your home office, located upstairs in your farmhouse. Use your hard-earned money to buy everything from tools and building materials to feed and fuel. This convenient feature ensures you spend more time farming and less time worrying about supplies.

Office Perks

But that's not all! Your office isn't just for managing farm supplies. It's also a place where you can unwind and connect with loved ones. Why not take a break from farming and give your girlfriend a call? It's a small touch that adds a personal dimension to your farming life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/0f4eb870fae7e8735178cfa25c7e24ccfe377d0b.jpg

Don't Miss Out on the Steam Summer Sale!

As a reminder, the Steam Summer Sale is the perfect time to grab amazing deals on games. And speaking of great deals, why not take a "call" to Steam and check out the Barn Finders game? They're currently running the exciting Treasure Hunt Plane Accident event, and soon enough, you'll be able to visit a farm in their world thanks to a free upcoming DLC!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/991170/Barn_Finders/

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for Family Land - Farmer Simulator. Stay tuned for more updates as we work hard to bring you the best farming experience possible.

Happy farming and happy summer!

Best wishes, The Family Land - Farmer Simulator Team

notes.title: Devlog #20: Hilarious Moments from Family Land - Farmer Simulator! 🌾😂
notes.content:
Hello, fellow farmers! 👩‍🌾👨‍🌾

Welcome to another devlog for Family Land - Farmer Simulator! Today, we’re pulling back the curtain to show you some of the funniest moments from our development journey. Buckle up, because it’s going to be a hilarious ride!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/3d0a4b7ceaf50f1fa1e732716f2b4476b9895780.jpg

1. The Hyperactive Chicken 🐔

Ever tried feeding a chicken only to have it act like a jackhammer? Neither had we, until this happened. One of our early bugs had our chickens behaving more like construction tools than barnyard animals. Check it out:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/6882305c744ad908d250d5aed9b6941615967afa.gif

2. Uncle Bill's Drunken Dance 🎉

Meet Uncle Bill—or at least, the unfinished version of him. For a while, Uncle Bill had a habit of breaking into a drunken dance at the most inopportune moments. Here he is, boogying like there's no tomorrow:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/30c73eb9a6b5bb63e5fd8c73ccaac4d8a5f75caf.gif

3. The Invisible Bushes 🚗🍃

We were cruising back home when we discovered a slight oversight—someone forgot to add collision to the bushes. This resulted in our car ghosting through the foliage as if it were a spirit of the forest:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/35162cf98075014e141ab5ee6ae160493b14e3f5.gif

Tractor rides are a staple of farm life, but ours turned into an extreme sport. Watch as our tractor attempts a gymnastic routine, flipping over after a run-in with a tree:

Entering your bedroom shouldn't be a challenge, but for a while, it was an epic quest. Our player character's T-pose meant navigating doorways sideways like a crab. If you wanted to get into bed, you had to get creative:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/f95b6a86bbec979c43a6fbab85cd6afe6dd4926f.gif

We hope you enjoyed this lighthearted look at our development process. Game development is full of surprises, and we’re grateful for your support and patience as we iron out the kinks.

Don't forget to add Family Land - Farmer Simulator to your wishlist and stay tuned for more updates as we continue to refine the game and bring you an amazing farming experience! 🚜✨

notes.title: 🌟 Devlog 19: Introducing the “Quick Cash” Mechanic! 🌟
notes.content:
Greetings, farmers! 👨‍🌾

Welcome to another exciting devlog for Family Land - Farmer Simulator. Today, we're thrilled to introduce you to a new mechanic that will add depth and strategy to your farming experience: the Quick Cash Mechanic. 💰

What is the Quick Cash Mechanic? 💸
In Family Land - Farmer Simulator, we understand that sometimes you need quick cash to keep your farm running smoothly. That's where the Quick Cash Mechanic comes in. With this feature, you can sell the products you've produced on your farm whenever you need some extra money.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/b430b11eeeafdb338a3de4cec36b944e4d1ba362.gif

Meet the brother-in-law: 👨‍🌾
To facilitate this process, we've introduced a character known as the brother-in-law. He's the go-to guy when you need to make a quick sale. Simply give him a call, and he'll arrive at your farm in his delivery van ready to purchase your goods. Whether it's corn, potatoes, or any other crop, the brother-in-law is here to help.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/3d520a400ee4c00c475b13b5eebe6cd7dab45896.gif

Why Choose the brother-in-law? 💼
While selling to the brother-in-law may offer lower prices compared to selling through traditional channels, he provides a convenient option for those times when you need cash fast. Whether you're facing unexpected expenses or just want to boost your funds, the brother-in-law has your back.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/c1fb2b7eea43848826e5ee9a6284f940bd1eab81.gif

What's Next? 🚜
As always, we're hard at work on improving and expanding Family Land - Farmer Simulator. Be sure to stay tuned for future updates and devlogs as we continue to refine the game and add new features based on your feedback.

Join Us in Fast Food - Restaurant Simulator! 🍔

One more thing:)  - our colleagues in the room next door have started working on a new title Fast Food - Restaurant Simulator🍔. We encourage you to visit the Steam page! 🎮🚀

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2971500/Fast_Food__Restaurant_Simulator/

Thank you for your continued support, and happy farming! 🚜
Your Family Land - Farmer Simulator Development Team 🛠️

notes.title: Family Land - Farmer Simulator Devlog#17 Introducing Irrigation Mechanics
notes.content:
Howdy Farmers! 🧑‍🌾 👩‍🌾 

We're back with another exciting update on Family Land - Farmer Simulator's development journey. Today, we're thrilled to introduce you to one of the key mechanics in the game: irrigation. In Family Land, ensuring your crops and livestock are properly hydrated will be crucial for maximizing your farm's productivity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/a3ea204b66a0493edf3284f1f314f91b3ccac63b.gif

Irrigating Crops: 🪣 🌾
One of the primary tasks you'll undertake as a farmer is irrigating your crops. Properly watering your fields will directly impact their yield and quality. With a systematic approach to irrigation, you can expect more bountiful harvests, leading to higher profits when you sell your produce.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/10235feb34e0b81f27fc0fe460865a04cb05e1f7.gif

Hydrating Livestock: 🪣 🐄 🐖
But it's not just your crops that need water; your livestock also require adequate hydration. Ensuring your cows and chickens have access to clean, fresh water will contribute to their health and wellbeing. Happy, healthy animals mean better quality products and increased revenue for your farm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/1232379a82d0b25df21e7aabe462676fa6da82e3.gif

Effect on Farming Results: 🌽 🌾
The effects of proper irrigation won't go unnoticed. More efficient watering practices will directly translate into higher yields and better-quality produce. This, in turn, will have a positive impact on the prices you can command for your products in the market.

Looking Ahead: 👀
While Family Land - Farmer Simulator is still in development, we're excited about the potential of the irrigation mechanic and its role in shaping your farming experience. We envision a dynamic simulation where every decision you make, including how you manage water resources, will influence your success as a farmer.

Integration with SuperStore: 🛒
Furthermore, we're hopeful that the products you cultivate on your farm will find their way to SuperStore, another game currently in development. This cross-game integration opens up exciting possibilities for expanding your farm's reach and profitability.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2466000/Superstore_Simulator/

Thank You: 🫵
As always, we want to express our gratitude to our amazing community for your unwavering support. Your enthusiasm drives us forward every day. Stay tuned for more updates on Family Land - Farmer Simulator development journey. Another devlog is on the horizon!

Happy farming!

notes.title: From today, Farm Simulator is Family Land - Farmer Simulator
notes.content:
Hello Farmers! 🌽 🚜

As you know the development of our farming simulator game is going very well and we can't wait to show you how the game looks and plays right now. But don’t worry, soon you will be able to tell, as we are taking part in the Farming Fest and you will be able to see the State of development video which shows you how the game looks in its current state.

And the game (except farming of course) is about a man that inherits his Uncle's farm and moves from his big city life to once again discover the joys of living off the land and remembering what is really important. That’s why we decide to change the name of our game to:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/8de3fb3d71be6c05fbdb95aa97a3e3de29c0bef9.png

With this change we want to bring you closer to William's family history and what was the relationship between John and his Uncle. But that’s a topic for a different devlog. 

For now stay tuned for Monday's materials so you can see in a video how the game presents itself. 

Have a great weekend!
Family Land - Farmer Simulator team

notes.title: Farm Simulator Devlog #10 📦
notes.content:
Greetings Farmers,

In the vast landscape of Farm Simulator, we're delving into a critical aspect that demands your attention – storage. Every fruit of your labor is susceptible to spoilage (the same goes for processed food, albeit at a slower pace). However, fear not, as there are methods to thwart this inevitable decay.

Building Capacity

Players must construct structures that amplify the farm's capacity, enabling the long-term preservation of food. When faced with excess corn and limited storage, choices become crucial – either feed it to the animals or swiftly sell it to the market, though the latter might not yield substantial profits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/5b825a8169c618c62905065579f0e28ebcbb0c6d.gif

Storage Solutions

Silos

Purpose: Grain storage.
Effect: Extends the shelf life of stored grain by 12 months. (The quality of the silo influences this duration; a poor silo might preserve corn for a month, while an excellent one can extend it to 2 years.)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/01ff5c59a7bc21fb1a36bbb7c1743e31decd61a6.gif

Cold Storage

Purpose: Holding products ready for sale.
Effect: Products in cold storage never spoil, but be mindful of the electrical power it consumes.


In this vast agricultural adventure, your decisions on storage will shape the destiny of your harvest. Make wise choices, expand your farm's capabilities, and let the bounties of your hard work endure. 

Happy farming!

The Farm Simulator Team 🚜🐔🥚

notes.title: Farm Simulator Devlog #9🐔
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/cdb06a2046a9d48620e72f5c0138882c66195cbc.jpg
Greetings, Farmers!

Today, we're clucking with excitement to introduce you to one of the beloved farm animals in Farm Simulator: chickens! These feathered companions play a crucial role in your farming journey, providing eggs, and meat when the time comes. But, just like any other creature in our simulation, chickens have their unique characteristics and requirements.

Understanding the Flock

Categories of Livestock:

In Farm Simulator, animals are categorized into different groups. Each category will have its designated shelter. For instance:

Cattle: Cowshed
Swine: Pigsty
Poultry: Chicken Coop
And other animals we'll introduce soon!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/c0f2535846a419134e47bd3f480c7b04dfc05e5f.gif

Care:

Caring for livestock in Farm Simulator involves several aspects, including:

Hydration: Ensuring your animals have access to water.
Satiety: Maintaining a minimum food saturation level of 20% for growth.
Dietary Preferences: Understanding each animal's preferred type of food.
Health: Keeping the animals healthy, with a maximum value of 20% cleanliness in their enclosures.
Contentment: Ensuring a minimum contentment level of 80%.

These aspects collectively determine the Quality Rank, a comprehensive evaluation of all statistics at the time of sale or product yield.

Meet the Chickens:

Today, we want to spotlight our feathery friends, chickens! In Farm Simulator, chickens come in various breeds, each with its unique traits. From the classic White Leghorn to the robust Rhode Island Red, you'll encounter a diverse range of chickens on your farm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/37a57a968d8afece10f4f30ce845fe187ea2d8d1.gif

Caring for chickens involves providing them with the right environment, a balanced diet, and regular attention to their well-being. Happy, well-cared-for chickens yield high-quality eggs and, eventually, meat when they reach maturity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/5871dd70ab687672845d367855049fc194ccea80.gif

We hope you're as egg-cited as we are about this addition to Farm Simulator! Chickens are just the beginning of the rich tapestry of farm animals waiting for you in our game.

Happy farming,

The Farm Simulator Team 🚜🐔🥚

notes.title: Farm Simulator Devlog #7 – Meet the Bill🧑‍🌾
notes.content:
Greetings, Farmers!

Today, we're thrilled to shed light on one of the most intriguing characters in Farm Simulator: Old Bill, the enigmatic inhabitant of the neighboring forest. Though wild and unpredictable, Old Bill serves a unique role on your farm, adding an element of delightful chaos to your daily routine. But there's more to this character than meets the eye; Old Bill plays a pivotal part in tracking your progress.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/516d64d76f7d016c7ab4e7b52f239dccc48940be.gif

Curious about what your uncle's house looks like? This is the first concept:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/5daea4239368883c904a26a0990285d4f3471c68.gif

Old Bill's Mischief Mechanics

Trapdoors:

Scattered across the farm are trapdoors leading to a network of tunnels Old Bill uses to disrupt your work. These tunnels are off-limits to players, allowing Old Bill to execute his mischievous deeds without interference. Some of his antics include:


Scaring the animals
Messing up the stables
Pilfering small resources
Blocking pathways


Building Respect:

As the farm conditions improve and successful transactions with Old Bill occur, your respect level with him grows. Enhancing this relationship yields small yet meaningful bonuses, such as:


Unique recipes
New machinery
Distinctive item skins


The ultimate goal for players is to forge an alliance with Old Bill, achieved through fulfilling his requests in exchange for maintaining the farm's tranquility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/89af52aad02ff1cb8d41865d0c36a950fafa2a57.jpg

The Allure of Alliance: A Farmer's Covenant

The alliance with Old Bill isn't just a deal; it's a covenant. By satisfying his orders, you'll earn his trust, unlocking exclusive opportunities and learning the secrets of the land. Your choices in this alliance will shape the future of your farm, as well as the dynamic relationship between you and Old Bill.

We're eager to see how you navigate this intriguing aspect of Farm Simulator. Your interactions with Old Bill will define your farming journey, adding depth and unpredictability to your experience.
Stay tuned for more! We'll be exploring these themes further in upcoming devlogs, so make sure to follow for the latest updates.

Happy farming,

~The Farm Simulator Team 🚜🌾

notes.title: Farm Simulator Devlog #6 – Introducing the vigilant scarecrow guard!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/c7ad2b2c6be78ae8516ba160623cfbb3dd7ebf2e.jpg
Hello, farmers!

Today we're happy to introduce one of the key features of Farm Simulator: the Scarecrow Guard. This vigilant guard will become an invaluable asset to your farm, protecting your crops from the constant threats of the natural world.

Scarecrow Guard: A Feathery Deterrent

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/0975788714f192b223e99344f87584c42cc071f3.gif

Scarecrow Guardians are not just a simple addition; they are an integral part of your farming journey. Placed strategically in the midst of your fields, these guards tirelessly scare away feathered intruders, ensuring that your crops remain untouched and intact.

Careful cultivation: balancing the forces of nature

In Farm Simulator, we delve into the complex balance of nature. It's not just about planting and waiting; it's about meticulous care. Cultivation is an art, and in our game it is divided into two critical aspects: manual care and mechanical maintenance.

Hand care:

Weeding: Keep your fields pristine by manually removing invasive weeds that steal vital nutrients from your crops.
Pest control: Vigilantly control pests with organic methods, ensuring your crops remain pest-free.
Spraying: Manually apply targeted organic solutions, protecting delicate plants from disease.


Mechanical maintenance:

Tractor spraying: Use your reliable tractor for larger-scale spraying, effectively covering vast areas.
Trapping mechanisms: Deploy strategic traps designed to capture harmful pests, including our Scarecrow Guard, a natural deterrent.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/3b14da7b0f910e426c19d91254120bc4e5e1e8d7.gif

Actual Pest Impact: A Challenge for Agriculture

In Farm Simulator, pests and parasites are not just nuisances - they are serious threats. They will have a direct impact on crop yields, leading to serious consequences for the farm. An effective pest control strategy will be the foundation for success in farming.
	
We would love your opinions on this important aspect of Farm Simulator's gameplay. Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to improve the game, providing a realistic, challenging and engaging farming experience for all players.

Stay tuned for more! We'll be exploring these themes further in upcoming devlogs, so make sure to follow for the latest updates.

Have a successful farming experience,

~Farm Simulator team 🚜🌾

notes.title: Farm Simulator Devlog #5
notes.content:
Corn Growth in Farm Simulator


Hey farmers! 👨‍🌾

We want to emphasize that game development is an exciting journey, and we're here to ensure you don't miss out on the fantastic experience.
Today, let's delve into the world of corn growth stages in our game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/04eb4adb57c8bd76e2d46929215c9cc05e34f65a.jpg

Farming is much more than simply planting and waiting – it's a dynamic and engaging process. Here's a concise overview:

1. From Seedling to Mature Plant:

Your corn journey begins with tiny seedlings pushing through the soil. With time and care, they grow into sturdy plants, leaves swaying in the breeze.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/3c9ca6325391fc30d29bba94482a6cb58bbea736.gif

2. Ripening into Harvest-Ready Corn:

As weeks pass, your corn plants mature - that's right! Your hard work paid off, and you just need to wait a little bit more until those kernels plump up and get that beautiful golden shade of yellow. 
It's time to harvest!  🌽🌽

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/de20c416b0bd35d12db105fca4c905bf338b24fd.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734944/2c86d2240a84430b9b8ae3990cb68dc62e2c81af.gif

3. Harvest:


Nourish Your Livestock or Boost Your Income: Your harvested corn plays a dual role on our farm. It can be used to feed your animals, ensuring their health and well-being, or you can choose to sell it in the market to increase your earnings and expand your agricultural empire.

In our farming world, you'll be cultivating a variety of crops, including the vital corn, to strike that perfect balance and harness the secrets of the land.

Keep an eye out for additional useful tips and the latest news from Farm Simulator.

Happy farming,
Farm Simulator Team
